name: ShengShou 3x3 War Drums Puzzle
description: The ShengShou 3x3 War Drums Puzzle is a striking 8-axis puzzle with a tapered, dome-like shape and three smooth-turning layers on each axis. Its unique mechanism and vibrant color scheme make it both visually impressive and mechanically satisfying. This puzzle offers a fresh and engaging challenge for anyone looking to explore beyond standard twisty puzzle designs.
